method: Per phase choose minimum-duration rank within the same case/iteration; divide by its own same-iteration trace-on operator span. Pre and signal minima may use different ranks and do not form an additive same-rank decomposition. Signal includes issue/poll and possible peer readiness; not pure network RTT or measured INC speedup.
limitations: Trace-on measurement image differs from main nohist/pre model and changes execution. Paired off/on measurement perturbation and run-order variation are documented in POST_STAGES.md.
